While this makes the specific test pass, it deletes essential functionality that prevents false negatives in side-effect detection and introduces a logical bug (infinite loop without proper termination condition).

By deleting the condition that returns early when encountering non-EXPR_RESULT/BLOCK ancestors, it allows the code to proceed and report warnings in cases where it previously didn't. This is overfitting to the specific test case rather than fixing the underlying bug logic.
